draft.shortGloss: to sit down; to rest on a chair
notes: This is a reflexive verb, so it requires reflexive pronouns (me siento, te sientas, se sienta, etc.).
It is common to confuse 'sentarse' (to sit down) with 'sentir' (to feel). Remember that 'sentarse' relates to your body position, while 'sentir' relates to your emotions or physical sensations.
